svg.title: The Lantingji Xu: the gathering, the text and the copies
svg.desc: A five-stage timeline from the 353 gathering at the Orchid Pavilion through the 324-character preface, the loss of the original in Taizong's tomb, the Tang copies and the 1965 authenticity debate, with panels on the text and the copies.
svg.text: THE GATHERING / THE TEXT / THE COPIES

g.text: FIVE STAGES / 五个阶段
353 / ORCHID PAVILION
41 guests, 37 poems / 四十一人，三十七首诗
THE PREFACE / 序文
324 characters, 28 columns / 三百二十四字，二十八行
649 / ZHAOLING
the original enters the tomb / 原件随葬昭陵
TANG / THE COPIES
Feng Chengsu's Shenlong copy / 冯承素神龙本
1965 / THE DEBATE
Guo Moruo questions the author / 郭沫若质疑作者
THE TEXT / 文本
324 characters / 三百二十四字
twenty different zhi / 二十个不同的“之”
joy, then death / 先写快乐，再写死亡
“death and life are great” / “死生亦大矣”
the finest running script / “天下第一行书”
THE COPIES / 摹本
the original is lost / 原件失传
Shenlong copy, Palace Museum / 神龙本，故宫
Dingwu stone rubbing / 定武本拓本
Yu Shinan, Chu Suiliang / 虞世南、褚遂良临本
copies, not the original / 都是摹本，没有原件
The original went into a tomb; the writing survived in copies.
原件进了陵墓，字靠摹本留下来。
The 1965 debate questioned the author; most scholars still accept Wang Xizhi. / 1965 年的论辨质疑作者，但多数学者仍归于王羲之。
